paper_metadata.title: Effects of Co content on tensile properties and deformation behaviors of Ni-based disk superalloys at different temperatures

evidence.quote: Effects of Co content on tensile properties and deformation behaviors of Ni-based disk superalloys at different temperatures
The effects of Co content on tensile properties and deformation behaviors of three Ni-based disk superalloys have been investigated.
The deformation microtwins enhance the yield strength and strain hardening ability at higher temperatures. On the other hand, they are responsible for the ITB behavior in the alloy.

These ingots were then hot extruded into 35 mm bars at about 1160 °C.
The extruded samples were heat-treated at 1100 °C/4 h (air cooling)
